    Flex90 Early Entry Benefits Available

    Flex90 Early Entry Benefits Available

    Making the decision to commit to an IRONMAN 70.3 can come with lots of considerations. Can I do it? What do I need? And, especially, in today’s world, what happens if my plans need to change?

    Fortunately, with Flex90, IRONMAN’s First 90 Days Registration offer, if your plans change, you can adjust your race date to fit your new goal. 

    Available benefits

    Fee-Free Transfer

    Partial Refund

    Register on or before 28 October 2026 to qualify for this offer.

    Learn more

  • Image

    World Championship Qualifier

    World Championship Qualifier

    Image

    For many athletes, qualifying for an IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship is the ultimate goal. It's the opportunity to test yourself against the best athletes from around the world and earn a place on triathlon's biggest stage.

    This event offers qualifying slots to the 2027 IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship.

    Learn about qualification

  • Image

    2025 Athletes Choice Award Winner

    2025 Athletes Choice Award Winner

    It’s time to celebrate the 2025 Athletes’ Choice Awards - honors determined entirely by you, the IRONMAN community. Your post‑race feedback shines a spotlight on the events that deliver unforgettable race-day experiences across the globe.

    IRONMAN 70.3 Aix-en-Provence was votest second Best IRONMAN 70.3 globally and second Best Swim Course and second Best Run Course in Europe, Middle East and Africa.

  • Image

    Buy Now, Pay Later

    Buy Now, Pay Later

    Training for race day starts with registration. To give athletes more flexibility, IRONMAN offers Buy Now, Pay Later options through Klarna, Afterpay, and Affirm.

    If eligible, you may be able to spread the cost of your registration over time instead of paying the full amount upfront. During checkout, you'll be able to review available payment plans and choose the option that works best for you.

    Available payment options

    Approval, eligibility, payment schedules, fees, and applicable terms are determined by the selected provider and will be presented before you complete your purchase.

Registration information

  • Athletes who register 60 days before the race will not have race materials personalized (name on merchandise apparel and name on race bib.) Athletes will also not be assigned a bib number until Athlete Check-In.
  • This event offers qualifying slots for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship.
  • Athletes must be 18 years of age on race day.

Online registrations are synced to our database within 24 hours. You will automatically receive a registration confirmation e-mail from our registration partner.

Your age group category for the event you registered for will be reflective of your age as of 31 December of the event year.

You can sign in to your IRONMAN profile to check your registration status at any time, below:
My IRONMAN profile >>

Your name, and the names of other starters will be searchable on the IRONMAN Tracker App the day prior to your race.

All transfer and partial refund/ withdrawals requests must be made in writing, at least 45 days before the scheduled race date of the event for which you initially registered.  Registration must be fully paid in order to redeem transfer or partial refund/ withdrawal benefits.  

Transfer or partial refund/ withdrawal options may only be redeemed once.

Please note that Relay registrations are excluded from this offer.

Fee-Free Transfer: Athletes may transfer their registration to any IRONMAN 70.3 event within the same calendar year, and within the same region as the original registration.

The administration fee will be waived however if transferring from a lower priced race to a higher priced race, athletes are required to pay the difference. If transferring from a higher priced race to a lower priced race, athletes will not receive a refund for the price difference.  We will make every effort to find a place at a race of the athlete’s choice, as long as the selected race has general entry availability. 

All transfer requests must be made in writing at least 45 days before the scheduled race day. Requests must follow the process outlined for the event region, as detailed here, on the transfers, deferrals and withdrawals page.

Partial Registration Refund/ Withdrawal: As a fully paid registrant, an athlete may request via writing a withdrawal and refund, minus initial processing fees (in all regions except Oceania where processing fees are included in the calculation) at the following rate:

Region Up to 4 months
prior to race day		Between 4 months and 45 days
prior to race day
Oceania45% refunded22% refunded
United States*50% refunded25% refunded
Canada50% refunded25% refunded
Europe50% refunded25% refunded
Africa50% refunded25% refunded
Asia50% refunded25% refunded


All withdrawal and refund requests must be made at least 45 days before the scheduled race date of the event for which you initially registered, and must follow the process outlined for the event region, here, on the transfers, deferrals and withdrawals page.

Exclusions:
  • IRONMAN 70.3 Hawai`i event is excluded from this offer.
  •  IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship event is excluded from this offer.

* Excluding Puerto Rico.

All athletes competing in France must hold a French Triathlon Federation license: either an annual license or a license experience without exception.

  • If you already hold a French Triathlon Federation (FFTri) license: Your registration is already complete, and no further action is needed.
  • If you hold a license from an affiliated country (Great Britain, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Norway, Portugal, Netherlands, Czech Republic, Sweden, Tahiti): Obtain a free FFTri license experience here. Be sure to provide your ITU license number and federation when ordering. Once you receive your license experience, your registration is complete.
  • If you hold a license from another country or do not have a license: Purchase a FFTri license experience here. Once received, your registration is complete.

Deadline: All participants must have a valid FFTri annual license or license experience by Wednesday, May 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM GMT+1.
➡️ No more double pre-event checks: everything is now automated by the FFTri. Once you have your license, your registration is fully complete.

Please note: no license will be sold at onsite registration.
Questions? Contact FFTRI at: [email protected]

Medical certificates are no longer required by the French Triathlon Federation. However, it’s mandatory to provide an annual French triathlon license or a license experience from the French Federation.

Withdrawal options are based on the date you registered for this event. Learn more about Europe, Middle East & Africa event withdraw policies >>

DOKEOP : Mandatory License Check

All athletes competing in France, without exception, are required to hold a French triathlon license or a competition pass:

  • If you hold a French Triathlon Federation (FFTRI) license: Upload a copy of your 2025 competition license to Dokeop.
  • If you hold a license from an affiliated country (Great Britain, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Netherlands): Get a free competition pass from FFTRI by clicking here and then enter your pass number on Dokeop. To receive the free pass, be sure to provide your ITU license number and federation when purchasing the pass.
  • If you hold another license or are unlicensed: Purchase an FFTRI competition pass by clicking here and enter your pass number on Dokeop.

All participants must upload one of the following documents to Dokeop before:

Wednesday, May 14th, 2025, at 12:00 PM GMT+1.

⚠️ No documents will be accepted when collecting race bibs.

Medical certificates are no longer required by the French Triathlon Federation. However, it’s mandatory to provide an annual French triathlon license or a competition pass from the French Federation.

To complete your registration, please upload your license or competition pass via the Dokeop platform:

  1. Click on the personal link in the email sent by Dokeop to access the form.
  2. Fill out the form to see which documents are required.
  3. Upload your license or competition pass.
  4. Wait for confirmation from Dokeop.

Useful information

  • Need help? Visit the Dokeop Help Center.
  • If you haven’t received your personal link, you can generate a new one here.
  • As a reminder, the email to submit your document is sent to the email address you provided when you registered.
  • Remember to check your spam folder to unblock emails from Dokeop if necessary to be sure to receive all the future emails.
  • If the email address you provided during registration was incorrect, you can contact us by email at: [email protected].
